text: At its meeting on February 3, 2020, the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board considered Item FB4.2, Ontario Green Screen.

The Economic and Community Development Committee: 1. Directed the Film Commissioner and Director, Entertainment Industries, to report to the next meeting of the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board on April 14, 2020 on current green initiatives already underway in the City of Toronto as well as the top ten park and public realm locations that could be considered for power drops.
